name: drive-invoice-to-xero

trigger.authentication_note: Google Drive dennis@work.flowers. The SAME connection is needed twice: here on the trigger (which polls the folder) and as the `gdrive` alias in --connections, because the workflow code renames the file.
trigger.trigger_note: Polling trigger (New File in Folder), one run per file added to the Invoices folder. No webhook_url — nothing external needs a catch URL, so there is no cutover step beyond turning the classic Zap off. Disabling the workflow moves the trigger to `released`; re-enabling reclaims it as `active` (verified 2026-07-28).

connectionless_apps.AICLIAPI: get_completion — authentication_id "0" (Included in Plan), no connection
connectionless_apps.ZapierTables: read via sdk.listTableRecords, not a TableCLIAPI action — no connection and no task cost

version_pinning_note: @zapier/zapier-durable 0.11.0 was npm-latest at build time but only ~20h old. The runtime installs with pnpm --config.minimumReleaseAge=1440, so a dependency younger than 24h fails at RUN time, not publish. Pinned to 0.10.1.

xero.organization_note: Used both as the `organization` input on Xero actions and as the `Xero-Tenant-Id` header on the raw request. _zap_raw_request has NO `organization` field in its schema (additionalProperties: false) and silently strips one — org-scoped calls fail with 'Please select an organization to perform this step on.' unless the header is set.
xero.bill_number_note: Zapier's new_bill `number` field maps to Xero's InvoiceNumber (not Reference) — verified against bills the classic Zap created.

bank_transactions.name: Xero Bank Transactions
bank_transactions.role: Read-only here. The match source for 'has this invoice already been paid?'. Chosen over a live Xero API query because Table reads cost no tasks.
bank_transactions.owned_by: the classic Zap 'Process New Reconciled Transactions' (Xero bank_transaction trigger -> TableCLIAPI create_record)
bank_transactions.coupling_warning: This workflow is only as correct as that Zap is current. On 2026-07-28 that Zap's create step was paused, so the Table had fallen ~5 days behind: 7 of 43 live SPEND transactions in 2026-06-01..2026-07-28 were missing, all of them the newest. The visible symptom was NOT an error — it was duplicate draft bills in Xero, deleted by hand. `tableStale` in the run output is the tripwire.

ai_model.note: Tier drives task cost: standard 1x, advanced 3x, premium 5x tasks per run (plus the same multiplier per tool call; this step makes none). Those three sentinels are the only valid values — anything else errors with 'Unknown tier sentinel'. Standard read every invoice in the README's verified table correctly, including the full line-item tables (19 rows on Vanta) and the tax-basis call. The classic Zap pinned google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite explicitly; the tier sentinel on built-in credentials replaces it. Re-run those cases before changing tier.
ai_model.file_input_note: The PDF is passed to the model as a file input (inputFieldConfig_Invoice_isFileUrl), using the Drive trigger's `file` hydrate reference. Standard reads rendered PDFs directly, so no Files by Zapier text-extraction step is needed — which is what makes the line-item table legible.

matching.rule: vendor (legal-suffix-normalised) AND exact total AND same currency AND SPEND, within +/-7 days of the invoice date or its due date
matching.note: Amount and currency are REQUIRED, not tiebreakers as the classic Zap's Agent had it. Anthropic had 3 transactions within 4 days of one invoice (104.58 / 133.58 / 99.00) — only the amount distinguishes the right one. SimplePay bills SGD 12 every month, so the date window is what stops a match against the wrong month. A split payment (Aspire FT 45.90 settled by 4.92 + 40.98) correctly fails to match rather than attaching to half of it.

description: Invoice PDF added to the Google Drive Invoices folder -> ONE AI by Zapier call extracts the header and the line items -> rename the file to '<invoice date> <vendor>' -> look for a matching SPEND bank transaction in the Xero Bank Transactions Zapier Table. Matched: attach the PDF to that transaction in Xero. Not matched: raise a DRAFT bill (guarded against duplicates by invoice number). Migration of the classic Zap 'Record New Bills in Xero'. Replaces its AI Agent step with deterministic code, requires an amount+currency match rather than treating amount as optional, merges its two AI calls into one, and reconciles extracted line items against the invoice total so a draft bill always adds up.

replaces_classic_zap.title: Record New Bills in Xero
replaces_classic_zap.old_shape: Drive trigger -> PDFs-only filter -> AI invoice header -> rename -> AI Agent 'Xero Invoice Transaction Matcher' (run_behavior, App222036CLIAPI@3.1.0, agent d9d3381a-6aeb-4221-b5f4-3623f68ea7cc) -> Paths -> second AI call for line items -> Paths on tax -> two Create Bill branches / Upload Attachment
replaces_classic_zap.agent_note: The Agent searched this same Zapier Table as a knowledge source; it existed to do fuzzy vendor-name matching across legal suffixes. `normalizeVendor` does that in code for free. The Agent also missed matches that were present in the Table — SimplePay 1148057 SGD 12 had an exact same-day transaction and still got a duplicate bill.
replaces_classic_zap.status: Dennis is turning the classic Zap off. Both were subscribed to the same folder.
